title: 'Another decade-defining book by Eric Ries?'
summary: Daniil Lanovyi (41 followers, 494 reviews on Goodreads) gives Incorruptible 5 stars and recommends it not just to entrepreneurs but to employees deciding what kind of organization they want to work for.
blockquote:
Another decade-defining book by Eric Ries? 
It's an absolute must-read for entrepreneurs, actual or wannabes. Most employees should also read this book to make up their minds about the types of organisations they want to work for. It would be amazing to have more incorruptible organisations in our lives.
